provenance: label_a and label_b come from two separate runs of one LLM, Claude Opus 5.5 (model id claude-opus-5-5), with the same written guidelines, and final and note from a third run that settled every disagreement. Blind reviews by further runs of the same model (2026-10-19 for the 81 items kept from the first sample, 2026-10-27 for the 319 redrawn ones) then changed three final labels, noted in the note column. The labels were then manually checked, and none was changed (reported 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-27).
sampling_rule: An error is a lexicon-ambiguous token (two or more length patterns for its skeleton in the system's own lexicon) of the soliloquies and tauber_beowulf test sets, pooled, whose predicted length pattern differs from gold. john_ws is not used. For each system, 200 errors were drawn with random.Random(1).sample. encoder_sentence: ByT5 sentence arm, seed 1, --max-bytes 2560, lr 3e-4, 5 epochs, zupitza_grammar left out of training (the selected configuration), lexicon = the other four training works plus WikiPron, pool 1,001 errors (532 prose, 469 verse). charsiug2p: CharsiuG2P IPA mapped to a length pattern, lexicon = all five training works plus WikiPron as charsiu_g2p.analyse used before D3, pool 2,624 errors (1,604 prose, 1,020 verse). charsiu_g2p.analyse now uses the D3 training set, which gives a pool of 2,588 (1,580 prose, 1,008 verse), and 3 of the 200 sampled tokens are not lexicon-ambiguous there. Five tokens appear in both samples and were typed separately.
